reviews.text:
Perhaps because the people who run stores around COEX have a lot of money, there are many franchise owners who discipline customers by calling their stores their own. That never happens at 7-Eleven in Japan.
If you want to do it like your own store, you can just take off the 7-Eleven sign and call it E-Mart.

reviews.author: Bumsang Kim
reviews.text: At Namul Wild Vegetable Bibimbap... I went there because I was curious because many foreigners are usually waiting in line... Stone pot bibimbap is originally more famous, but they say they don't do it in the summer season because it's hot... I completely understand haha. See the photo for menu and prices.

reviews.author: byungdo Ahn
reviews.text: There are many foreign customers, and when you eat there, you get the feeling that you went abroad after a long vacation and wanted Korean food, so you visit a Korean restaurant. The owner is friendly, the atmosphere is clean, and the food is delicious, so I visit whenever I get the chance. This is a place I want to bring my foreign friends when they visit.

reviews.author: Iphi Lee
reviews.text: This is my favorite bibimbap restaurant. There are only a few tables and not enough room for three people. I like it alone or with two people. The young male owner seems to be working alone, but he always serves a hearty bowl with good ingredients. It always makes me happy because it seems to give me a lively energy.

reviews.author: chaerin yoo
reviews.text:
A classic stone pot bibimbap restaurant that I will introduce to my foreign friends.
When ordering Beef Bulgogi Dolsot Bibimbap, I saw a review saying that men were given more rice and women were given less. I don't know if that's why, but there were too many toppings than rice, so the seasoning was a bit strong and I was a bit bitten by the time I finished eating it all. Next time, I'll have to ask for more food. That was the only thing that was disappointing, other than that, all the ingredients were fresh and clean. The owner is very friendly and the store is very clean. Willing to visit again

reviews.author: Woogeun Kim
reviews.text: Although it does not have the spicy taste of Jeonju-style bibimbap, it is a clean and luxurious bibimbap. Beef bulgogi adds richness to the neat vegetables. It's quite a luxurious bibimbap, and it's a restaurant frequented by Koreans as well as foreigners.

reviews.author: HYUNYONG HWANG
reviews.text:
Since it is pre-baked, there is no need to worry about odor.
It's near Sangsu in Hongdae, the prices are reasonable, and the variety of side dishes is good.

reviews.author: Seongwoo Jeong
reviews.text:
I was satisfied because the quality of the meat was better than I expected! The marinated ribs were sweet and soft, so I kept reaching for them. Because it has unlimited refills, it is good value for money, and the side dishes come out neatly. The staff were friendly and the store was clean.

Overall Review: A meat restaurant with excellent taste, price, and service! Willing to visit again!

reviews.author: Hanna
reviews.text: By my standards, it just feels delicious..? It would be better if they gave me ssamjang instead of seaweed, kimchi instead of pickled radish, and ssamjang instead of the strange sauce... Ugh, rather than saying it's not delicious, I keep thinking about ssamjang and vegetables. The soybean paste stew was delicious. At first, they gave me some boiled bean sprouts and mushrooms, but really, why did they give me this and tell me to eat it with something..? I feel like I don't fit in well, I feel like I'm playing separately. Kimchi fried rice tastes just like the kimchi fried rice that comes when you order it delivered. It tastes very delicious with a lot of oil and msg. The menu said it would take about 15 minutes because the meat was grilled inside, but it felt like it came out a little quickly, so I wondered if it had been grilled in advance inside the hooksi and warmed up a bit before it came out. It's not that the meat isn't delicious, but since it's not ribs grilled right in front of you, there's definitely no juiciness. I think the price set was 40,500 won, and I was full after eating it all haha. It was definitely convenient because the meat was grilled.

reviews.author: Kyuseo Shim
reviews.text:
For lunch, I had a combination of ribs and (water) cold noodles.
The taste of the grilled ribs was good. The meat was cut into slightly thicker pieces, so it was soft and chewy, but the fat was a bit tough, which was a bit disappointing. They also served a slightly spicy sauce, and I felt that the flavor of the ribs went up even more when I dipped it in it. Three people ordered the same menu and received ribs in one bowl.
The cold noodles were plentiful and tasty. Depending on your taste, you may want to use vinegar or mustard sauce.
The store was small in size and the overall interior was clean and cool. There weren't many customers so there was no waiting.

reviews.author: hyunhak kim
reviews.text:
Tender ribs and neat composition!
Sangsu Station is good for people in Hongdae, especially those in their 20s and 30s.
No need to grill meat, soft and delicious special sauce
Thanks to its cost-effectiveness, it is perfect for enjoying without burden.

reviews.text: At Budae Jjigae... Unlimited refills of Ramen Sari... See photos for menu and prices~

reviews.author: Kyuseo Shim
reviews.text: It is a budae stew restaurant that is cost-effective and tastes good. Whenever I feel like Budae Jjigae, I come here. The menu is Budae Jjigae. The staff will initially bring rice, side dishes, and water. If you want to eat more, you can get unlimited refills of ramen noodles. Don't leave it for me.

reviews.author: Jose Kim
reviews.text:
The taste is good, but the soup seems a bit lacking in freshness.
They boiled the noodles by adding them from the beginning, but I thought it would be right to remove the noodles and add them later while boiling, so I did that.
I wonder if seasoning is necessary for the refreshing taste of the soup.

reviews.author: Manager Kong
reviews.text:
Budae stew restaurant located on the main road from Sangsu to Hapjeong.
I pass by it often, but maybe because it's on the second floor, it's easy to miss if you don't look for it carefully.
Perhaps because there are a lot of seats, it's not always crowded and the servers are friendly.
The first taste seems a bit bland to my taste buds, which are accustomed to salty tastes, but once it boils and the soup boils down, it's just right and it's delicious.
In addition to Budae Jjigae, they also sell pan steaks, which are delicious. Perhaps because of that, there are not only young people but also families with children.
The price is reasonable and the quantity is large, so the value for money is satisfactory.

reviews.author: Iphi Lee
reviews.text: This is a very good budae stew restaurant. Ramen and rice are refilled for free. However, Budae Jjigae is now 1,000 won... It's sad.

address: Room 101, Sangsu Kimchi Samgyeopsal, 76 Dokmak-ro, Mapo-gu, Seoul, South Korea

reviews.author: Yuna Seong
reviews.text: It's been a while since I found a delicious pork belly restaurant with an old-fashioned atmosphere. As the name suggests, the kimchi is really delicious. If you eat moderately ripe old kimchi, bean sprouts, and grilled green onion kimchi, the meat disappears quickly. During dinner time, it is crowded with customers. The soybean paste stew served as a service is also very good!

reviews.author: Day by day
reviews.text:
This is an old-fashioned kimchi pork belly restaurant that is open until late at night near Sangsu Station. The meat quality of the pork belly was especially good.
True to its name, Kimchi Samgyeopsal, it comes in three types of kimchi and of course goes well with pork belly, and the friendly service was a bonus.

reviews.author: Shinyanya
reviews.text: Sangsu Kimchi Pork Belly, the best kimchi pork belly restaurant found on the cafe street in Unseo-dong! We only serve Boseong Nokdon Special Samgyeop, carefully selected with more than 10 years of experience and know-how, so the meat quality is excellent. Especially when you grill fresh raw pork belly with homemade kimchi, the savory and sour combination is fantastic. We had a full meal with the perfect combination of steamed egg and fried rice. Thanks to the clean store and friendly staff, we highly recommend this restaurant near Unseo Station!

reviews.author: Boram
reviews.text:
This is a famous meat restaurant in Sangsu-dong, Mapo.
I highly recommend this place as it has a great atmosphere, great value for money, and has all the best in terms of taste. It seems like a great place for group gatherings or company dinners, and it's also a great place to visit with lovers or friends.

It's a completely old-fashioned restaurant with great sensibility.
Because we use refrigerated Korean pork, it has no smell and is delicious!
Eating meat and fried rice is a must

The kimchi is also cut into little finger-sized pieces, making it easy to eat.
The basic side dishes are as simple as pickled onions, pickled perilla leaves, kimchi, and green onions.
I had a delicious meal. Ssamjang, salt, and whole garlic are also provided as standard.

The side dishes are at least cheap so it's good enough.
Best suited for eating meat? Stick to the basics? Number of side dishes
There is a set menu so you can eat at a cheaper price.
